vectors.name: two-digit-transitions
vectors.description: A folded bullet after a two-digit marker is reported.

vectors.name: two-digit-first
vectors.description: A folded bullet below a two-digit content column is reported.

vectors.name: one-digit-first
vectors.description: A folded bullet below a one-digit content column is reported.

vectors.name: ordered-continuation
vectors.description: A folded ordered marker is reported.

vectors.name: innermost-item
vectors.description: The innermost matching item supplies the content column.

vectors.name: bullet-host
vectors.description: A folded ordered marker inside a bullet item is reported.

vectors.name: paragraph-after-blank
vectors.description: A marker folded into a later paragraph is reported.

vectors.name: escaped-marker
vectors.description: An escaped marker remains literal text.

vectors.name: nested-marker
vectors.description: A marker at the content column nests.

vectors.name: sibling-marker
vectors.description: A marker at the host marker column starts a sibling.

vectors.name: wrapped-text
vectors.description: A plain continuation line is not a marker.

vectors.name: missing-space
vectors.description: A marker without a following space stays text.

vectors.name: auto-numbered
vectors.description: The auto-numbered marker avoids the changing-width trap.

vectors.name: after-blank
vectors.description: A marker below the content column after a blank starts a separate list and is reported.

vectors.name: after-blank-same-kind
vectors.description: A bullet one column in after a blank leaves the item's list.

vectors.name: after-blank-second-item
vectors.description: Only the first marker of the detached list is reported.

vectors.name: after-blank-past-a-nested-item
vectors.description: The item the marker is below supplies the content column, past a nested item it has left.

vectors.name: after-blank-at-content-column
vectors.description: A marker at the content column after a blank nests and is not reported.

vectors.name: after-blank-at-marker-column
vectors.description: A marker at the item's marker column after a blank is a sibling.

vectors.name: after-blank-paragraph-between
vectors.description: A paragraph between the item and the marker ends the item's reach.

vectors.name: after-blank-continuing-number
vectors.description: Numbering that continues is ordered-list-split-by-indent's finding, not this rule's.

vectors.name: outside-list
vectors.description: A paragraph outside a list has no host item.
